doc: Every kind of request the runtime sends to the executing model, with how training covers it. A new model-facing call site (ts-host/src) or serving route (serve/http.py) fails tests/neuralese/test_model_call_kind_coverage.py until it is declared here with its SFT target, RL action treatment and rendering-parity test. Status 'covered' names evidence files; 'gap' names an owner and its section in the audit; 'not-applicable' gives the reason. Audit: plans/neuralese/TRAINING_DATA_COVERAGE_AUDIT_20261028.md.

tool-loop-turn.summary: An ordinary turn of a natlang call: reasoning, tool calls (eval, return_result, ...), typed answers; includes the opening, template readouts, repair turns after rejected actions and protocol-failure retries.

runtime-authored-call.summary: A natlang call whose instructions the runtime or a host tool writes: refinement:holds (no scoring driver), the iterateOn progress judge (builtin progressJudge), bash ask, natlang ask (CLI), nl@python, the delegate tool's directory reducer, the specializer's compareBehaviors judge. Each runs as tool-loop turns, so the generic mechanisms apply; their data coverage is measured in the audit.

decision-readout.summary: A finite-typed call answered by scoring every allowed JSON value as the reply (readout: decision, decisionReadout: finite-returns, decide()).

refinement-judge-scored.summary: A refinement predicate (Is<T, P>, refine) judged by one scoring pass over true/false with JUDGE_SYSTEM_PROMPT (native/refinement.ts decisionJudge), when the driver can score.

careful-review.summary: Optional review of a pending action batch (model.review): a forked turn that must call review_write with reason and decision.

view-write.summary: The Neuralese instance of builtin view(value, instructions?): template writes of the value at a view site (POST /v1/neuralese/view).

parity.reason: the server renders the view site itself (view.py); nothing in ts-host constructs serverViewer

native-forced-write.summary: Forced producers: write-text materializes a string as native state (Neuralese<string> arguments, soft-body placeholders); init-body encodes a soft body in its real rendered call context.

sft.reason: forced text has no sampled target; its state is trained through the consumers that import it

/v1/neuralese/grad.reason: learning: gradients of recorded objectives (consumes recordings of the kinds above)

/v1/neuralese/guidance/check.reason: crisp guidance verdict on a given reply; no model call

/v1/neuralese/render.reason: prompt rendering diagnostic; no model call
